name: Albox (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided light blue over white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Albox (ears of wheat on yellow above blue).
history: Albox was authorised by royal decree of 5 November 1979 to adopt its symbols, but did not do so until November 2004; the flag is a rectangular cloth one and a half times longer than wide, divided horizontally sky blue above and white below with the local arms superimposed at the centre.

features.role: Albox arms — ears of wheat above blue
